card.name: Frequency and date words ending a time phrase
card.fires_on: The last word or digit of a time expression, such as 'twice a', 'twice daily', 'every 48 hours', or the final digit of a year. It also fires on 'study entry' and on a month name after 'in'.

modes.label: Dosing frequency
modes.description: The closing word of a how-often phrase after 'twice' or 'every'.
modes.example: in whom a change to twice<< daily>> darunavir tablets 60

modes.label: Year digits
modes.description: A digit inside a four-digit year in historical text.

modes.label: Time anchor
modes.description: A study milestone or month used as a time point.
modes.example: 80% received prophylactic anticoagulation at study<< entry>>.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning 'each time', 'every year' and 'every month', which pushes the output toward recurring-time wording.
card.plain: It lights up at the end of a time phrase such as 'twice daily' or a year, where a word about how often something happens may follow.
